user.title: Connect to Codex Voice
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local, subscription-backed Codex Voice bridge.

data_description.access_token: The token configured on the local bridge. This is not your ChatGPT OAuth token.
data_description.bridge_url: The HTTP URL Home Assistant uses to reach the bridge.

reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current access token for the local Codex Voice bridge.

error.realtime_authority_already_configured: Another conversation agent already provides realtime Home Assistant tools. Disable it there before enabling this agent.

data.name: Name
data.realtime_authority: Provide Home Assistant tools to realtime voice
data.session_fallback: Explicit identity for a single satellite without device ID

data_description.context_mode: New profiles answer independently and use short context only for follow-ups, answers to questions or explicit continuation. Existing profiles keep their previous behavior.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Select the Home Assistant LLM APIs whose exposed entities and tools this agent may use.
data_description.prompt: Instructions supplied before the conversation. Templates are supported.
data_description.realtime_authority: Exactly one conversation agent may provide tools to realtime voice. Tool access is limited to the Home Assistant APIs selected above.
data_description.realtime_language: Language and locale used for realtime tool context and responses.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Choose low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or ultra; higher effort can improve difficult reasoning at the cost of latency.
data_description.service_tier: Priority targets lower latency and increases subscription usage compared with standard.
data_description.session_continuity: Retain bounded context per device and known HA user. When disabled, no previous context is reused. Existing profiles keep their original session behavior.
data_description.session_idle_minutes: Inactivity after the last completed turn; default 15 minutes.
data_description.session_fallback: Leave empty normally. Only use a dedicated profile for one satellite without a reliable ID. All unidentified callers of that profile share this explicit binding.
data_description.session_metadata: Legacy mode only: save hashed owners, random session IDs and timestamps. Independent mode always keeps context in RAM only.

init.title: Experimental Codex speech-to-text
init.description: This diagnostic provider repurposes Codex realtime conversation and may time out without a transcript. For a reliable Assist pipeline, use Home Assistant's Wyoming integration with local Whisper instead.

data_description.prompt: Optional vocabulary or context that can improve transcription.

init.title: Text-to-speech provider
init.description: Speech generation uses Codex realtime conversation as a best-effort compatibility adapter. It can paraphrase or expand text and is not suitable where exact wording is required.

data_description.instructions: Optional instructions for tone, pacing, accent, or emotion.
